zh-CN: 特别感谢 Xuanzebufeng 在兼容性问题上提供的建议。
en: Special thanks to Xuanzebufeng for suggestions on compatibility issues.

zh-CN: 优化部分UI和UX
en: Improved parts of the UI and UX.

zh-CN: 修复房间导出检查和待改名房间的异常提示，补全 RTM 房间设置与区域坐标读取，支持自动同步和缺失文件手动导入，恢复项目 JSON 导出。
新增预览部件选择、轮廓高亮和名称提示，可调整高亮颜色与提示开关。
新增参考图，支持移动、远近缩放、前后层与透明度调整。
新增 X轴、Y轴对称绘制。
en: Fixed room export checks and errors for rooms pending a rename. Completed RTM room settings and region coordinate reading, added automatic syncing and manual import for missing files, and restored project JSON export.
Added preview part selection, outline highlights and name tooltips, with highlight color and tooltip settings.
Added reference images with movement, depth scaling, front/back layers and opacity controls.
Added X-axis and Y-axis painting symmetry.

zh-CN: 修复破损房间的坐姿、拖动和珍珠漂浮问题，修复人偶移出房间时的报错、Rained 同步及重复应用失败，新增编辑器日志导出。
en: Fixed sitting, dragging and floating pearls in damaged chambers, errors when an iterator is removed from a room, Rained syncing and failures when reapplying rooms. Added editor log export.

zh-CN: 修复房间预设应用、区域连接和项目 ZIP 导出问题，完善报错提示与外部色板兼容，修正部分透明度计算。移除图层多余说明，新项目默认保留贴图原色。
en: Fixed room preset application, region connections, and project ZIP export issues. Improved error messages and external palette compatibility, corrected some opacity calculations, removed unnecessary layer instructions, and made new projects preserve original texture colors by default.

zh-CN: 修复房间设置与区域坐标导出遗漏，支持多个作品一起导入导出，补充外部地图模组打包兼容，并调整导入导出界面。
en: Fixed missing room settings and region coordinates in exports, added multi-project import and export and external map mod packaging, and improved the import/export UI.

zh-CN: 修复部分独立导出模组造成的游戏卡顿。
en: Fixed game slowdown caused by some standalone exported mods.

zh-CN: 调整了交互逻辑和UI界面。
en: Adjusted the interaction logic and UI.

zh-CN: 修复路径选择窗口无法正常显示及重复选择时报错的问题。
修复剧情对话与语音试听冲突的问题。
修复独立导出模组的印记与珍珠读取判断。
修复误收其他模组错误提示的问题。
补充游戏内菜单进入与返回的淡入淡出。
修复房间列表和投影预览读取未启用模组资源的问题。
修复 Rained 自定义素材路径与房间同步失败的问题。
优化导出界面，先选择内容，再选择格式。
新增项目 ZIP，包含对应房间及可选的额外房间。
新增整片区域打包，保留区域文件与依赖信息。
新增图层右键菜单，支持重命名、向下合并、删除与剪辑蒙版。
补充迭代器显示异常的诊断记录。
新增原版迭代器 DM、CL、SL、SS 珍珠读取者。
新增地图选房与房间位置预览。
优化区域连接界面。
新增房间色板与重力设置。
新增原版投影缓动与中英文对照，修复缓动预览。
新增诊断等级设置。
修复游戏退出后编辑器进程残留的问题。
修复房间导出遗漏地形色板的问题。
修复同时加载多个导出模组时的贴图冲突。
修复原版环境音校验与最新房间设置读取。
补充 RegionKit 额外色板导出。
优化演算室性能。
新增完整地图模组导出与剧情入口。
新增封面与纵深场景编辑，入口：外观调整 → 导出 → 导出完整地图模组 → 封面与场景。
调整剪辑蒙版层级显示，取消图层名称下划线。
新增 RainocTool 广播 JSON 导入导出，支持广播图标颜色编辑。
新增 RainocTool 入口，优化 Discord 图标提示。
整理各编辑页面的参数层级与作用范围。
修复导出选项丢失与旧广播样式被覆盖的问题。
新增五块卵石、仰望皓月、残破、不规则和多屏演算室房间预设，支持尺寸选择和房间替换。
新增第三方房间资源检查，导出时可选择冲突版本，保留本地作品。
en: Fix file selection dialogs failing to appear and errors when selecting a path again.
Fix conflicts between story dialogue and voice previews.
Fix mark checks and pearl reading in standalone exports.
Fix unrelated mod errors being reported by MI.
Add fade transitions when entering and leaving the in-game menu.
Fix room lists and projection previews reading resources from disabled mods.
Fix custom Rained asset paths and failed room synchronization.
Reorganize export options: choose content before the format.
Add project ZIP export with the matching rooms and optional additional rooms.
Add whole-region packaging with region files and dependency information.
Add a layer context menu with rename, merge down, delete, and clipping masks.
Add diagnostic records for iterator rendering issues.
Add pearl readers for the vanilla iterators DM, CL, SL and SS.
Add map-based room selection and room position previews.
Improve the region connection interface.
Add room palette and gravity settings.
Add native projection easing with translated names and fix easing previews.
Add diagnostic verbosity settings.
Fix editor processes remaining after the game exits.
Fix missing terrain palettes in room exports.
Fix texture conflicts when loading multiple exported mods.
Fix native ambient audio validation and loading of the latest room settings.
Include RegionKit extra palettes in exports.
Improve chamber performance.
Add complete map mod export with a story entry.
Add cover and depth scene editing, available under Appearance → Export → Export complete map mod → Cover and scenes.
Adjust clipping-mask hierarchy display and remove layer-name underlines.
Add RainocTool broadcast JSON import and export, with broadcast icon color editing.
Add a RainocTool link and improve the Discord icon tooltip.
Reorganize settings by object and scope across editor pages.
Fix lost export preferences and overwritten styles in older broadcasts.
Add Five Pebbles, Looks to the Moon, damaged, irregular and multi-screen chamber presets with size selection and room replacement.
Add third-party room asset checks and export version choices while preserving local projects.

zh-CN: 受时间和个人开发维护精力限制，本次更新还没来得及完成所有功能的实机测试。项目 ZIP、独立模组导出、新增房间预设与尺寸、完整地图的单人剧情与 Meadow 联机、游戏内纵深场景，以及 Steam 退出状态尚未完成完整验证；偶发半透明问题仍在排查。如果遇到 bug，请及时到 Discord 反馈。
en: With limited time and the workload of developing and maintaining this project on my own, I have not been able to test every feature in-game. Project ZIPs, standalone mod exports, the new room presets and sizes, complete maps in single-player Story and Meadow multiplayer, in-game depth scenes, and Steam returning to its stopped state still need full validation. The intermittent transparency issue is still under investigation. Please report any bugs on Discord.

zh-CN: 本次 debug 测试使用了匿名用户的作品「pool moon」。
en: Debug testing for this update used pool moon, a work by an anonymous user.

zh-CN: 本次导出测试使用粉笔的 OC「渺宇一砾」（myys），包含五颗珍珠和投影动画。
en: Export testing for this update used 粉笔's OC 渺宇一砾 (myys), including five pearls and a projection animation.

zh-CN: Windows 64 位工坊包内置 Python 3.13 与 Pillow 环境，可一键启动，无需手动安装。
修复旧启动配置导致编辑器版本混用的问题。
简化游戏路径识别与 Rained 初始配置。
修复未配置游戏路径时本地编辑受阻的问题。
游戏内界面改用原版翻译接口与英文原句翻译表。
工坊包仅保留独立导出所需的 C# 源码。
改用原版接口查找模组资源，支持游戏版本目录。
修复独立导出模组首次读取失败后无法恢复的问题。
修复部分提示与默认台词的语言显示。
修复禁用模组后的音乐与语音清理。
精简界面文案。
en: Bundle Python 3.13 and Pillow in the 64-bit Windows Workshop package for one-click startup, with no manual environment installation.
Fix old launch configurations loading editor code from a different MI package.
Simplify game path detection and initial Rained setup.
Fix local editing being blocked when the game path is not configured.
Use the native translator and English source strings for the in-game UI.
Keep only the C# sources required for standalone exports in the Workshop package.
Use the game's asset lookup with support for game-version folders.
Fix standalone mods failing to recover after an initial content-loading failure.
Fix localization of several messages and default dialogue lines.
Fix music and voice cleanup when disabling the mod.
Simplify interface text.

zh-CN: 修复游戏内头后线颜色同步。
F8 面板新增迭代器语音总开关。
修复新旧项目语音无法播放的问题。
演算室预览支持临时忽略交流印记试听语音。
语音音量上限提高至原来的两倍。
修复网页与游戏作品库不同步的问题。
优化游戏内的菜单 UI。
优化了删除功能。
优化 Discord 图标。
修复预览重置与好感数据读取异常。
en: Fix in-game head-cable color synchronization.
Add an iterator voice master switch to the F8 panel.
Fix voices not playing in new and existing projects.
Allow chamber previews to temporarily ignore the Mark of Communication for voice testing.
Double the maximum voice volume setting.
Fix project libraries being out of sync between the web editor and the game.
Improve the in-game menu UI.
Improve project deletion.
Improve the Discord icon.
Fix preview reset and affinity data reading errors.

zh-CN: 演算珍珠的堆积位置按室内可活动区域定位，修复贴墙堆积和恢复零重力后不归位的问题。
撤销和重做绘画时保留当前部件、画布视角和面板滚动位置，包括切换部件后的第一笔。
选择绘画部件后，自动展开并定位左侧对应参数。
投影图片可直接替换并撤销替换，保留已有轨道和关键帧；整理素材操作与轨道参数布局。
支持从画布外起笔，笔划在图像边缘自然裁切；完全未碰到图像的操作不留下编辑记录。
en: Align work-pearl pile positions with the chamber’s usable interior and fix pearls collecting against walls or failing to return after zero gravity resumes.
Keep the selected part, canvas view and panel scroll positions when undoing or redoing paint, including the first stroke after switching parts.
Selecting a paint part automatically expands and scrolls to its corresponding settings on the left.
Replace projection images and undo replacements while preserving tracks and keyframes; tidy asset actions and track controls.
Start strokes outside the canvas and clip them at the image edges; gestures that never touch the image do not create edit history.

zh-CN: 修正演算环背后柔光被原版更新覆盖的问题，颜色、强度、范围和开关按当前项目保持同步。
统一房间渐变在没有色标时的网页预览与游戏颜色。
en: Keep the current project’s rear glow color, intensity, range and visibility synchronized after native light updates.
Match the room-gradient web preview to the game when no color stops are present.

zh-CN: 新建迭代器使用随模组提供的 Rained 等待房间，修正默认连接出口。
未编辑过的旧默认等待房间可在再次应用项目时升级；保留自行编辑的房间和外部房间连接。
en: New iterator projects use the bundled Rained waiting room with the correct connection exit.
Reapplying a project upgrades unchanged legacy waiting rooms while preserving custom rooms and external connections.

zh-CN: 首次发布：整合外观、对话与珍珠、广播、投影、区域连接编辑和独立模组导出。
新增游戏主菜单“更多迭代器”，集中查看演算室、广播和珍珠预览。
统一网页撤销与重做，整理表单、图层、悬停和可拖动分栏。
广播支持角色绑定颜色与 RainocTool 1.1.2 JSON 导入；实验语音支持剧情台词试听与自定义声线。
项目关联内容可预览后选择保留、删除或迁移，保护共享珍珠并保留恢复记录。
发布包从空作品库开始，包含中英文界面、更新记录、感谢名单和 Discord 反馈入口。
en: Initial release with appearance, dialogue and pearl text, broadcast, projection and region-connection editing, plus standalone mod export.
Added the More Iterators main-menu hub for chamber, broadcast and pearl previews.
Unified undo and redo, compact forms, texture layers, hover styles and resizable panels.
Added speaker-bound broadcast colors and RainocTool 1.1.2 JSON import, plus experimental dialogue-based voice previews and custom presets.
Related project content can be kept, deleted or transferred after a preview, with shared-pearl protection and recovery records.
The public package starts with an empty library and includes Chinese and English interfaces, update history, acknowledgements and Discord feedback.
